gpu_audit_scope: Same selected GPU per host; idle at every cell entry; 10-second samples retained. Container NVML cannot resolve host process names, so samples do not establish continuous exclusivity.
acceptance: Primary Torch2.13 lossless eager clears the 1.5% campaign E2E gate and is pixel-exact. Torch2.11 lossless is 1.485%, below that gate. High is exact within mode but has the pre-existing SSIM0.830311 difference from lossless; lossless is recommended. BCG is unsupported.
